audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Joshua / Yehoshua Jordan-crossing and ark-procession narrative, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for camp movement, ark distance, sanctification, Joshua's public confirmation, priests' instructions, flood-stage Jordan, Adam/Zarethan geography, and dry-ground crossing.

verses.restored: Joshua rose early in morning, and they set out from Shittim and came to Jordan, he and all children of Israel, and lodged there before they crossed.

familiar.text: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.

verses.restored: It was at end of three days that officers passed through midst of camp.

familiar.text: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;

verses.restored: They commanded people, saying, When you see ark of covenant of YHWH your Divine and Levitical priests carrying it, then you shall set out from your place and go after it.

familiar.text: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.

verses.restored: Yet there shall be distance between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure. Do not come near it, so you may know way by which you shall go, for you have not crossed by this way before.

familiar.text: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.

verses.restored: Joshua said to people, Sanctify yourselves, for tomorrow YHWH will do wonders in your midst.

familiar.text: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

verses.restored: Joshua spoke to priests, saying, Carry ark of covenant and cross before people. They carried ark of covenant and went before people.

familiar.text: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

verses.restored: YHWH said to Joshua, This day I will begin to make you great in eyes of all Israel, so they may know that as I was with Moses, I will be with you.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.

verses.restored: You shall command priests carrying ark of covenant, saying, When you come to edge of waters of Jordan, in Jordan you shall stand.

familiar.text: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.

verses.restored: Joshua said to children of Israel, Draw near here and hear words of YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither, and hear the words of the LORD your God.

verses.restored: Joshua said, By this you shall know living Divine is in your midst and will surely dispossess from before you Canaanite, Hittite, Hivite, Perizzite, Girgashite, Amorite, and Jebusite.

familiar.text: And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

verses.restored: Look, ark of covenant of Lord of all earth is crossing before you into Jordan.

familiar.text: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the LORD of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.

verses.restored: Now take for yourselves twelve men from tribes of Israel, one man, one man from each tribe.

familiar.text: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.

verses.restored: It shall be, when soles of feet of priests carrying ark of YHWH, Lord of all earth, rest in waters of Jordan, waters of Jordan shall be cut off, waters descending from above, and they shall stand as one heap.

familiar.text: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the LORD, the LORD of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.

verses.restored: It was, when people set out from tents to cross Jordan, priests carrying ark of covenant before people,

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;

verses.restored: and when carriers of ark came to Jordan and feet of priests carrying ark were dipped in edge of water—Jordan overflows all its banks all days of harvest—

familiar.text: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)

verses.restored: then waters descending from above stood and rose as one heap very far away at Adam, city beside Zarethan, and waters descending toward sea of Arabah, Salt Sea, were completely cut off; and people crossed opposite Jericho.

familiar.text: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.

verses.restored: Priests carrying ark of covenant of YHWH stood firmly on dry ground in midst of Jordan, and all Israel crossed on dry ground until all nation finished crossing Jordan.

familiar.text: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

translation_notes: The ark leads at a deliberate distance, combining guidance with a boundary around sacred danger and visibility.
Sanctification prepares the people for a communal crossing; it must not be turned into purity shame or exclusion of disabled, menstruating, sexually active, or otherwise embodied people.
The narrative explicitly links the crossing sign to dispossession of seven peoples, so the miracle cannot be ethically detached from its conquest frame.
Jordan is described at flood stage during harvest, heightening the narrative's wonder claim.
Adam, Zarethan, the Arabah, and the Salt Sea create a concrete geographic memory, though exact historical and hydrological reconstruction remains debated.
The text presents dry-ground crossing as Divine action; modern reception should neither demand pseudoscientific proof nor use the story to dismiss natural explanations or archaeology.
Joshua's public elevation is tied to continuity with Moses, but leadership confirmation must not become a cult of greatness.
safety_note: Do not use Joshua 3 to justify land seizure, purity policing, charismatic leader worship, or claims that miracles validate conquest. Center careful preparation, sacred boundaries, collective passage, and the memory that a people crosses together rather than through one leader's power alone.
